character_types: flashy woman in big red hat
visual_synopsis: Three women sit around a low table in a bright living room drinking tea and picking at fruit and sweets: a neatly dressed young woman in a black suit with a white collar, a flashy woman in a huge red hat and red floral blouse, and a loud curly-haired woman in a yellow floral outfit who is clearly a man in drag. The entire sketch is one static tea-table conversation, shot in close-ups of the three reacting to each other.
